top_news.title: AI Gateway, Web Search API - Introducing Web Search API
top_news.dek: Cloudflare launches a beta Web Search API for AI agents to ground responses in real-time data.
top_news.brief: The API integrates with AI Gateway and supports providers including Ceramic.ai, Exa, and Linkup. All providers offer Zero Data Retention and adhere to verified bot crawling standards, enabling developers to bypass training cutoffs.
top_news.image_alt: Cloudflare Web Search API architecture diagram

top_news.title: Claude Code's new Mods system lets developers rewrite the AI coding tool from the inside
top_news.dek: Anthropic has introduced a Mods system for Claude Code, allowing developers to extend the tool using JavaScript or TypeScript.
top_news.brief: The new plugin-based architecture enables developers to hook into Claude Code's internal events, such as tool calls and user prompts. This allows for the creation of custom UI panels, the interception of tool executions, and the implementation of entirely new command-line functionality.
top_news.image_alt: Claude Code interface showing custom plugin integration

top_news.title: Show HN: Made an open-source Lego AI generator
top_news.dek: LDraw-Nova is an open-source agent tool that generates 3D Lego models from natural language prompts.
top_news.brief: Powered by Astra and Opus 5.5, the agent translates user ideas into LDraw-compatible source code. The output includes 3D models, glTF files for Blender, and interactive VR support for Meta Quest 3, along with a full log of the agent's reasoning process.
top_news.image_alt: 3D rendered Lego model generated by AI

top_news.title: Inside-Out AI: Rebuilding Airbnb Behind the Scenes and Across the Guest Experience
top_news.dek: Former Meta generative AI lead Ahmad Al-Dahle is spearheading an AI-driven transformation at Airbnb.
top_news.brief: As Airbnb's CTO, Al-Dahle is applying his experience from the Llama model development to overhaul both internal product development workflows and the end-to-end guest experience on the platform.
top_news.image_alt: Ahmad Al-Dahle speaking at a tech conference

top_news.title: Google: The latest AI news we announced in September 2026
top_news.dek: Google's September 2026 update highlights the release of Gemini 4 Argon and new connected app integrations.
top_news.brief: The latest updates include the rollout of the Gemini 4 Argon model and expanded capabilities for Connected Apps within the Gemini ecosystem. Additionally, Google introduced WeatherNext 3, showcasing ongoing integration of generative AI across its core product suite.
top_news.image_alt: Google Gemini logo and interface elements
